newsitem.title: USA: IMM currencies end mostly lower, but sterling up.
newsitem.headline: IMM currencies end mostly lower, but sterling up.

text.p: Nov 27 - IMM currencies ended lower except for sterling, which closed up but off its highs. Yen weakness and sterling strength the features, with trade in those contracts moderate. One trader said a strong dollar should return Friday. Trading closed early today, will be suspended Thursday for Thanksgiving, and will end early again on Friday. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
